nodes.label: Locked Public Pages Rule
nodes.rationale: index.html, download/index.html, and guides/index.html are locked unless the user explicitly replaces the rule.

nodes.label: Repository Hygiene Rule
nodes.rationale: Generated screenshots, captures, probes, review artifacts, and temporary outputs should stay out of committed source.

nodes.label: Graphify Update Rule
nodes.rationale: Before cleanup or structural changes, agents should update graphify-out so future agents inherit current project structure.

nodes.label: Public Asset Rule
nodes.rationale: Public/live image assets belong under static/, while docs/redesign/captures is not an asset library.

nodes.label: Redesign Capture Archive Cleanup
nodes.rationale: Historical screenshot captures were removed from version control and should be regenerated temporarily under tmp/.

nodes.label: Download-first Funnel
nodes.rationale: The primary conversion is the Windows installer download; guides are secondary support.

nodes.label: SEO Expansion Gate
nodes.rationale: New SEO pages require a real intent cluster, distinct funnel job, quality implementation, and small tested batch.

nodes.label: Download Page Handoff
nodes.rationale: The download page should deliver the installer and hand the visitor into onboarding.

nodes.label: Truthful Offline Sync Story
nodes.rationale: The route visual should show an order stored off Wi-Fi and synced after returning to the local network.

nodes.label: Simple Guides Surface
nodes.rationale: The classroom/course-player direction was superseded by a simple video guide surface.

nodes.label: QR Menu Launch Stance
nodes.rationale: A standalone QR/menu SEO page should wait because measured demand is weaker than PDA and order-taking.

nodes.label: Mobile Viewport Density Fix
nodes.rationale: The mobile homepage route should be less populated, with simplified sizing and stacked controls.

nodes.label: Evidence-Gated Hub Implementation
nodes.rationale: The existing generic hub should become a dated evidence index, but compatibility, customer, outcome, and independent claims remain blocked until their fact IDs reach the required evidence class and implementation is explicitly approved.

nodes.label: Repository Evidence Boundary
nodes.rationale: Private source, maintained contracts, and tests can support narrow first-party architecture and workflow facts, but they do not establish broad environmental compatibility, customer outcomes, or independent validation.

nodes.label: Owner-Cancelled Interactive Execution
nodes.rationale: The owner directed that POSPal not be installed for this SEO project, so the proof record is closed at installer identity, integrity, signature, and embedded-version evidence and cannot support runtime compatibility or executed-workflow claims.

nodes.label: Existing-Page Improvement Strategy
nodes.rationale: The generic hub and wireless page already own distinct buyer intents, so Release 1 increases information gain with source-verified workflow facts instead of creating another generic URL or broadening into unsupported claims.

nodes.label: Ordering Workflow Not Fiscal POS
